title: Hyperion's Applause by qubodup
author: qubodup
sourceDescription: People clapping and cheering after a performance of "Hyperion. Briefe eines Terroristen" in the Schaubühne in Berlin, Germany. Recorded with a Zoom H2 and leveled and normalized in Audacity. Also removed a click and a voice piece at the end.
modifications: cut 1.90-7.90s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -14.10 dBFS); 30 ms fades
